entities.summary: Jane Somerville is a British emeritus professor of cardiology at Imperial College, London, who is best known for defining the concept and subspecialty of grown ups with congenital heart disease (GUCH) and being chosen as the physician involved with Britain's first heart transplantation by Donald Ross in 1968.
